object.content: The other day, I bought a domain as an impulse purchase. I was looking around to see what was available and found this one for $10 for the first year. I saw a spot for a promo code and searched Google for it and found a coupon that got me the domain for less than a dollar for a year. I'm hosting it right now from Github pages which is good enough for what I'm doing so far (and it's also free). I don't know what I'm going to put on my landing page yet, but right now I just have a  Google+ widget. I added an "Engineering Experiences" tab where I put information about classes I've taken, workshops I've been to, and projects I've made (which I wrote in Markdown). I plan on using Github project pages to fill in some other tabs, plus I'm redoing my electric imp-controlled relay project and can host the site there. I'm using Google's web starter kit for the responsive layout so it functions as both a desktop and mobile app with minimum work from me. I'm hoping I can put to use my web development skills that I've gathered over the years.
